name: Residual Spell (Metamagic)
body:
Your spells leave behind a lingering effect in the area they affected.

Benefit: The area a residual spell affects is considered difficult terrain for 1 round/spell level.

A residual spell uses up a spell slot equal to the spell’s actual level.
